subject: Information Theory
title: Camouflage and Deception
description: A quick win: understand Camouflage and Deception.

hook.text: A stick insect looks like a twig. A predator's eyes pass right over it. Camouflage is information warfare.

buildup.text: Camouflage reduces the mutual information between the prey's presence and the predator's visual signal.

discovery.text: The prey suppresses the signal. The predator can't distinguish prey from background—the channel capacity drops to zero.

twist.text: Counter-deception evolves: predators develop search images that break camouflage for common prey patterns.

climax.text: It's an information arms race: prey minimize their signal, predators maximize their detection ability.

punchline.text: Hide the signal, survive. Camouflage is anti-information.

quiz.question: How does camouflage work in information-theoretic terms?
options: It reduces the mutual information between the prey and the predator's visual input
